title: In re Korean Eastern Presbytery
summary: The SJC found that Korean Eastern Presbytery complied with its citation by providing the materials required under BCO 40-1, then referred those materials to the Committee for Review of Presbytery Records. Compliance with the production requirement did not itself constitute substantive approval of the submitted records.

sources.locator: lines 11-15; Minutes p. 590, adopted March 1, 2018 action
sources.supported_claims: Supports citation compliance, production of BCO 40-1 materials, and referral to records review.

source_limits: The brief action does not identify the underlying records issues or decide their substantive adequacy.
evidence_notes: The satisfied duty was production of necessary materials under BCO 40-1.
The materials, not an adversarial case, were referred for further records review.
No substantive approval of the records was adopted.

score_reasons.concrete_dispute: Identifies citation compliance, though the underlying records issue is not published.
score_reasons.decisive_reason: Identifies provision of the required materials.
score_reasons.distinctive_value: Separates filing compliance from substantive approval.
score_reasons.fidelity: Does not infer a merits ruling.
score_reasons.economy: Fits the brevity of the adopted action.

verification_notes: Separate source-checking pass by the same reviewer re-read the entire adopted action at lines 11-15 and confirmed the limited supervisory result.
